name: create_kms_issuer_policy
description:
Attach a policy to a KMS issuer that grants a project's deployments permission to sign with it.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/policies --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

environments.description: The environments for the project grant policy. Each entry is a system environment (production, preview, development) or a custom environment ID (env_...).

projectId.description: The project ID for the project grant policy.

tokenClaims.description: The claims that KMS should include in signed JWTs for this policy.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
